newsitem.title: INDIA: Daewoo Finance India may get new partner after CRB.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Finance India may get new partner after CRB.

text.p: Daewoo Finance India, the Indian arm of the South Korean securities firm, may have a new local partner following the collapse of CRB Capital Markets, one of its local partners, company officials said on Friday.
CRB Capital Markets is the flagship of the CRB group which is facing a winding up petition at the Delhi High Court following charges of irregularities.
"They are only a minority shareholder," a Daewoo Finance India official said about CRB. "To meet their liabilities, their stake may be sold to a third party," he said.
The company's name was changed to Daewoo Finance India from CRB Daewoo after CRB's holding was cut to 24 percent from 50 percent last October.
The Korean firm now holds 50 percent, and CRB 24 percent. The balance is held by Indian firms known to Daewoo, officials said.
